# FET Black Tie Event

> The Night of Excellence — University of Buea Faculty of Engineering & Technology Black Tie Gala on 4 July 2026 at Amelia Apart Hotel, Bokwai-Buea. Reserve tickets and send anonymous shout-outs.

## About

The FET Black Tie Event is a formal gala organised by the University of Buea's Faculty of Engineering & Technology. It brings together students, alumni, faculty, and distinguished guests for an evening of celebration, networking, and entertainment. The event features live performances, a curated dinner, and a digital shout-out wall where attendees can send anonymous messages projected during the night.

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://fet-black-tie.mybrainboostapp.com/): Event details, live countdown timer, ticket tiers (Classic, VIP, Tables), and booking form.
- [Send a shout-out](https://fet-black-tie.mybrainboostapp.com/message): Submit an anonymous message to be displayed on the live wall at the event.
- [The Wall](https://fet-black-tie.mybrainboostapp.com/board): Real-time display of approved shout-outs projected during the gala.

## Ticket Tiers

- **Classic** — 5,000 XAF (1 seat)
- **Classic Couple** — 9,000 XAF (2 seats)
- **VIP Classic** — 10,000 XAF (1 seat, premium)
- **VIP Couple** — 18,000 XAF (2 seats, premium)
- **Table of 5** — 30,000 XAF
- **Table of 5 VIP** — 50,000 XAF
- **Table of 10** — 100,000 XAF

Online booking closes 30 June 2026. Payment is processed via Fapshi (Mobile Money / Orange Money).

## Key Details

- **Date:** 4 July 2026, 6:00 PM
- **Venue:** Amelia Apart Hotel, Bokwai-Buea
- **Dress Code:** Corporate
- **Contact:** 676 658 443
- **Organiser:** University of Buea — Faculty of Engineering & Technology
